sam_ops: @here launching a tiny L100 dedicated pool in Mexico City (mex1) for preview pilots today. Pool: `dedicated-L100-mex1-preview`. Initial cards: 8. Purpose: reduce LATAM p95. :rocket:

julia_pm: Quick ask: any special billing or reservation caveats?

sam_ops: Preview pricing applies; reservations supported. Fallback policy: mex1 -> sfo1 -> hosted. We will surface fallbacks in the Console.

leo_sre: Rollout timing and probes? Need to add alarms.

sam_ops: Canary at 2026-04-02T16:00Z for 60m, then scale to preview. Probes: `mex1-l100-health` and `mex1-l100-p95`. Runbook: internal link (ops). Pause criteria: fallback >6% in 15m or error-rate >0.4%.

ana_sales: I'll notify pilot customers. Any migration CLI snippet?

sam_ops: Example:
```
rb-reserve --pool dedicated-L100-mex1-preview --size 2 --duration 14d
```

mike_ce: Will quantization profiles be preloaded?

leo_sre: Two common profiles preloaded (fp8 and int8-lite). Custom models need one-time compile. UI warns on reservation.

julia_pm: Adding console banner: "mex1 L100 preview may fallback to SFO1 during canary".

deploy-bot: Deployment started for pool `dedicated-L100-mex1-preview` at 2026-04-02T16:00:12Z (canary).

sam_ops: Please monitor p95 latency, KV cache hit-rate, and fallback %. CE/Sales brief scheduled tomorrow 09:30 PT. Calendar invite sent. :white_check_mark:
